Triage: `pm:queue`, type Bug, routed `domain:spec` as a cross-domain single-PR exception (triage-designated per the exception path). Rationale: of the two sites, the schema JSDoc (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` `App.defaultAgent`) is spec-lane text by standing rule (everything touching `packages/spec` goes to the spec seat), and the second site (`packages/client/src/index.ts` JSDoc) is a one-sentence rider on the same fact — not worth a second card. Claim comment must declare the full file surface (both files, JSDoc-only).

Resolution direction, by standing rules rather than a fresh ruling: **correct the docs** — both sentences assert runtime behaviour that does not exist, and a doc claiming a security-relevant scoping guarantee that isn't enforced is exactly the declared≠enforced class this repo removes. The alternative ("make the bare endpoint agent-resolved") is a behaviour change for every bare-chat caller, lands in the cloud repo, and would supersede cloud#1487's just-landed gate — that is a Feature with no measured pull; if anyone wants it, it needs its own decision card, not this one. Text-only fix ⇒ no acceptance-face change ⇒ `Clause-②: no` expected.

Size/model suggestion: S (two JSDoc corrections), spec text tier.
